title: Complete Guide to Log Aggregation
title_es: Guía Completa de Agregación de Logs
description: Runnable Fluent Bit to Loki pipeline: Docker Compose with Loki, Grafana and a Fluent Bit agent, a pino structured logger emitting JSON, and a shipper config with labels, parsing and disk buffering.
description_es: Pipeline ejecutable de Fluent Bit a Loki: Docker Compose con Loki, Grafana y un agente Fluent Bit, logger estructurado pino que emite JSON, y configuración de shipper con labels, parsing y buffering en disco.
